title: Facebook Registration Assistant Update v1.6.0
description:
• Auto-Detect Pre-opened Portfolio Modal: Immediately fills and submits 'Create your business portfolio' if already open, or triggers it via 'Continue with Facebook' if not open.
• Elimination of False Success & Blank Tab Leaks: Never clicks external target='_blank' links on 'Unable to access Meta Business Suite' screens. Directs straight to business portfolio setup.
• 100% Genuine 3-Way Live Verification: Strictly verifies page existence in Meta Business Suite and Pages Manager before saving to database or marking Success. Traps rate limit dialogs accurately.
• Cookie Health & Expiry Auto-Detector: Fast multi-threaded pre-flight testing to instantly categorize cookies as Active, Checkpoint, or Expired with a 1-click 'Keep Active Only' queue filter.
• Cyberpunk UI & Compact Controls: Polished spinboxes, 1s/2s/3s/None pacing delays, and 4s/5s/6s airplane holds.
